Actus reus
- Enters a building or part of a building as a trespasser with intent to steal.

Mens rea
- Intent to steal at the time of entry.

Common defences
- No intent to steal; permission to enter.

Sentencing
- Third domestic burglary: minimum 3 years under s.111 Powers of Criminal Courts (Sentencing) Act 2000 unless unjust.
